hadith:
Merits of Sunnah - Narrated by Kulaib bin Wail -  Volume 4, Book 56, Number 697 

I asked Zainab bint Abi Salama (i.e. daughter of the wife of the Prophet, "Tell me about the Prophet . Did he belong to the tribe of Mudar?" She replied, "Yes, he belonged to the tribe of Mudar and was from the offspring of An-Nadr bin Kinana."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Quddus - الْقُدُّوسُ - The Purest

The name Al Quddus emphasizes the purity and sanctity of Allah. It signifies that Allah is free from any imperfection and holds perfect holiness. This name is often invoked in prayers and supplications to highlight the divine essence of purity and to seek closeness to Allah through recognition of His holiness.
verse:
Al-Mutaffifin - The Defrauding - 83:22-23

Surely the virtuous will be in bliss, ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.
